description: This file defines various filter classes for dashboards in the Superset project, including filters for title, slug, creation, favorites, tags, access rights, roles, certification status, and creator. It also contains logic for applying these filters to database queries.

classes.name: DashboardTitleOrSlugFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards by title or slug.

classes.name: DashboardCreatedByMeFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards created by the current user.

classes.name: DashboardFavoriteFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards marked as favorite by the user.

classes.name: DashboardTagNameFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards associated with a specific tag name.

classes.name: DashboardTagIdFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards associated with a specific tag ID.

classes.name: DashboardAccessFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards accessible to the user based on ownership, publication, roles, and embedded access.

classes.name: FilterRelatedRoles
classes.description: Filter for dashboards related to specific roles.

classes.name: DashboardCertifiedFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards that are certified.

classes.name: DashboardHasCreatedByFilter
classes.description: Filter for dashboards that have a creator assigned.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method implemented in each filter class to apply the filter criteria to a database query.
